messages:
deploy-bot: Config-only deploy scheduled: `rtx-config` v2.3.1 -> changes: limits & timeouts (req_timeout=6s), routing policy tweak (preferred: regional_fallback), batching params (max_batch=8, max_wait=12ms). Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Canary 5% for 10 minutes, then 25% for 20m. Rollback window 60m. /deploy/1758881234

maria: Quick q — are we doing KV prefix warmup for the canary? last time cold KV caused p99 spikes.

ben: Yes, plan includes a warmup probe. Sequence: 1) route 5% to canary 2) run kvprobe job to touch common prefixes 3) monitor p50/p95/p99 for 10m. If p99 > baseline+120ms -> rollback.

ops-jen: Need explicit rollback steps here so oncall can act fast. Ben can you paste the pin/unpin commands? Also add which dashboard panels to watch.

ben: Pinned commands (ops CLI):
```bash
# pin routing to v2.3.1 for my-tenant
opsctl routing pin --tenant my-tenant --model rtx-config --version 2.3.1
# unpin (rollback):
opsctl routing unpin --tenant my-tenant --model rtx-config
# force rollback to v2.2.9 if needed:
opsctl routing pin --tenant my-tenant --model rtx-config --version 2.2.9
```
Watch panels: `inference.latency.p95`, `inference.kv_cache.hit_rate`, `inference.errors.rate`, `serving.cpu_util`. Set alerts: p95 > baseline+80ms OR kv hit_rate drop > 8%

maria: Thanks. For warmup, I'll kick off the kvprobe job once canary flips. Probe command:
```bash
kubectl run kvprobe --image=tools/kvprobe:latest -- /kvprobe --tenant my-tenant --prefixes-file prefixes.txt --concurrency 10
```
It will run for ~3m.

ops-jen: @maria @ben good. Also add a safety guard: auto-unpin if error rate > 1% sustained for 2m. Can we wire that?

ben: Yep — deploy config includes auto-unpin rule in routing policy: `auto_unpin_on_errors: {threshold: 0.01, window_secs: 120}`. I've added it to the canary patch.

sam: I'll be on pager during change window. I'll watch: p99, kv hit_rate, and 5m error spike. If anything tilts, I'll trigger `opsctl routing unpin` and post here. :thumbsup:

maria: small note — batching tweak (max_batch 8) might reduce tail latency variance but could increase throughput costs. Ops is okay with that trade for this patch?

ben: yes, finance verbally approved a small bump for this canary. We'll revert batch param on rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion scheduled: 23:05 UTC -> 5% live. Automated warmup job will run at +30s. Monitoring window starts now.

sam: ack. I'll monitor and post quick status updates.

ops-jen: Leave the deploy thread open for 60m after final promotion. If we see stable metrics by +40m, we proceed to 100% ramp. If not, rollback immediate.

maria: created short runbook in /runbooks/kv-warmup-canary.md and attached to the deploy ticket.

ben: I'll be available for fast rollback if needed. Posting rollback checklist in the ticket now.

sam: thanks all — watching. :eyes:
